name: omp-roundtable
description: Round-table delivery for Oh My Pi: seats hold identity tickets derived from a local agenda state and GitHub facts.

recomputeIntervalSeconds.description: Timer recompute interval in seconds (design Q7).

dataDir.description: Directory of the agenda state files (<dataDir>/state). Default: <agent dir>/omp-roundtable.

ownerAgent.description: Agent type owner seats are spawned as (R2).

gateAgent.description: Agent type review, accept, postMerge and closure seats are spawned as (R3).
